name: Inspect HVAC air filter
description: Check filter condition and airflow.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow equipment instructions and local guidance.

name: Replace disposable HVAC filter
description: Replace the filter using the size and rating specified for the system.
recommendation_note: Actual interval depends on filter type, system, household conditions, and manufacturer instructions.

name: Test smoke alarms
description: Test every smoke alarm using its test function.
recommendation_note: Follow the alarm manufacturer's testing instructions and local requirements.

name: Test carbon monoxide alarms
description: Test every carbon monoxide alarm using its test function.
recommendation_note: Follow the alarm manufacturer's testing instructions and local requirements.

name: Inspect fire extinguishers
description: Check accessibility, pressure indicator, seal, and visible condition.
recommendation_note: Follow the extinguisher manufacturer's instructions and applicable fire-safety guidance.

name: Clean refrigerator condenser coils
description: Clean accessible coils as directed by the appliance manufacturer.
recommendation_note: Follow the appliance manufacturer's cleaning and access instructions.

name: Clean clothes dryer vent
description: Clean lint from the vent path and verify airflow.
recommendation_note: Frequency depends on use and vent configuration; clean sooner if airflow is reduced.

name: Clean rain gutters
description: Remove leaves and debris and check downspouts.
recommendation_note: Adjust for tree cover, roof design, and local weather.

name: Winterize irrigation system
description: Prepare the irrigation system for freezing weather.
recommendation_note: Schedule before freezing conditions; use a qualified service provider when needed.

name: Test sump pump
description: Test operation and inspect the pit and discharge line.
recommendation_note: Adjust frequency based on local water conditions and manufacturer guidance.

name: Test GFCI outlets
description: Use each GFCI outlet's test and reset buttons; confirm downstream protection where applicable.
recommendation_note: Follow device instructions. Contact a qualified electrician if a device fails to trip or reset.

name: Check visible plumbing for leaks
description: Look under sinks and around toilets, supply lines, and exposed pipes for drips or moisture.
recommendation_note: This is a visual check; have persistent moisture or suspected concealed leaks assessed.

name: Inspect washing machine hoses
description: Check accessible washer hoses and connections for bulges, cracks, corrosion, or leaks.
recommendation_note: Replace damaged hoses promptly and follow washer and hose manufacturer recommendations.

name: Clean washing machine
description: Run the manufacturer's washer-cleaning cycle and clean the dispenser and door gasket as directed.
recommendation_note: Use only products and procedures approved by the appliance manufacturer.

name: Clean dishwasher filter
description: Remove and rinse the filter and check the sump area as directed by the manufacturer.
recommendation_note: Follow the dishwasher manual; ensure parts are reinstalled correctly.

name: Clean range hood filter
description: Clean or replace the range hood grease filter as directed.
recommendation_note: Frequency depends on cooking habits. Do not operate without the required filter.

name: Replace refrigerator water filter
description: Replace the refrigerator water filter if the model uses one.
recommendation_note: Use the specified filter and follow the appliance indicator and manufacturer schedule.

name: Clean bathroom exhaust fan grille
description: Remove dust from the accessible fan grille and verify the fan operates.
recommendation_note: Turn power off before cleaning; leave electrical work or inaccessible components to a qualified person.

name: Check water softener salt
description: Check the brine tank salt level and refill if needed.
recommendation_note: Only add the salt type recommended by the water softener manufacturer.

name: Inspect toilet for leaks and running
description: Check for continuous running, leaks at the base, and moisture around supply connections.
recommendation_note: Address leaks promptly to prevent water damage.

name: Inspect bathroom and kitchen caulk
description: Check wet-area caulk and grout for gaps, cracking, or deterioration.
recommendation_note: Repair with materials suitable for the surface and location; investigate recurring moisture.

name: Inspect door and window weatherstripping
description: Check seals for gaps, compression, cracking, or detachment.
recommendation_note: Replace damaged seals with compatible materials.

name: Clean window and sliding-door tracks
description: Remove debris from accessible window and sliding-door tracks and clear drainage paths.
recommendation_note: Follow window and door manufacturer cleaning instructions.

name: Test garage door safety features
description: Test photo-eye sensors and the auto-reverse function using the door manufacturer's procedure.
recommendation_note: Keep people and objects clear. Stop using the opener and arrange professional service if safety features fail.

name: Inspect deck, porch, and exterior steps
description: Look for loose railings, damaged boards, unstable steps, corrosion, and visible deterioration.
recommendation_note: Avoid loading unsafe structures; have structural concerns assessed by a qualified professional.

name: Inspect visible foundation and drainage
description: Look for new cracks, water pooling, soil movement, or blocked drainage near the foundation.
recommendation_note: This is a visual check, not a structural assessment. Seek professional advice for significant changes.

name: Inspect and clean accessible outdoor AC unit
description: Remove loose leaves and debris around the outdoor unit and check that airflow is unobstructed.
recommendation_note: Schedule for spring. Disconnect power before any permitted cleaning; do not open electrical compartments or bend fins.

name: Prepare outdoor faucets for freezing weather
description: Disconnect hoses and prepare hose bibs according to the home's plumbing and faucet design.
recommendation_note: Schedule before freezing weather. Follow frost-free faucet instructions; use a plumber if shutoffs or drainage are unclear.

name: Arrange chimney and fireplace inspection
description: Arrange an inspection and cleaning when applicable for the home's fireplace, stove, and chimney.
recommendation_note: Use a qualified chimney professional and follow appliance and local fire-safety guidance.

name: Inspect roof and flashing from the ground
description: From a safe location, look for missing shingles, damaged flashing, debris, or visible sagging.
recommendation_note: Do not climb onto the roof. Arrange a qualified roofer for closer inspection or repairs.

name: Check exterior dryer exhaust outlet
description: Check that the exterior dryer exhaust flap is unobstructed and opens during operation.
recommendation_note: Do not insert tools into the vent while the dryer is operating; clean the vent path as needed.

name: Check accessible attic for moisture
description: From a safe access point, look for visible leaks, damp insulation, or unusual staining.
recommendation_note: Do not step off safe walkways or disturb insulation; use a professional if access is unsafe.

name: Clean showerheads and faucet aerators
description: Remove mineral buildup from accessible showerheads and faucet aerators as appropriate.
recommendation_note: Use cleaning methods compatible with the fixture finish and manufacturer guidance.

name: Test sump pump backup system
description: If installed, check the backup pump or battery system using its manufacturer's test procedure.
recommendation_note: Follow manufacturer instructions; replace batteries on their specified schedule.

name: Review water heater maintenance requirements
description: Check the water heater manual for due maintenance such as flushing or anode-rod inspection.
recommendation_note: Actual maintenance varies by model and water conditions. Use a qualified technician for gas, electrical, pressure, or hot-water work.

name: Arrange furnace heat-exchanger inspection
description: Have a qualified technician inspect the heat exchanger and combustion components where applicable.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Professional inspection only; follow the furnace manufacturer's service schedule.

name: Arrange heat-pump inspection and service
description: Have a qualified technician inspect system operation, refrigerant circuit, electrical connections, and controls.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use a qualified HVAC technician and follow manufacturer service intervals.

name: Inspect and clear HVAC condensate drain
description: Check the accessible condensate drain outlet and pan for blockage, standing water, or overflow.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow equipment instructions; do not use chemicals or access components unless approved by the manufacturer.

name: Clean and inspect whole-home humidifier
description: If installed, clean the water panel or reservoir and inspect the drain and water feed.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use the model-specific maintenance procedure and replace consumables as directed.

name: Clean dehumidifier filter and reservoir
description: Clean the filter and reservoir and check the drain hose if the unit has one.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Unplug the appliance first and follow its cleaning instructions.

name: Inspect HRV or ERV filters
description: If installed, inspect and clean or replace ventilation-unit filters as directed.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Filter intervals vary by model, outdoor air quality, and use.

name: Inspect accessible HVAC ductwork
description: Look for disconnected, damaged, crushed, or visibly leaking accessible ducts.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not enter confined spaces; use an HVAC professional for repairs or inaccessible ductwork.

name: Check thermostat operation and settings
description: Verify heating and cooling modes, schedules, batteries, and displayed temperature.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow thermostat instructions and avoid changing installer-only settings.

name: Inspect visible furnace venting and flue
description: From a safe location, look for visible damage, disconnection, corrosion, or obstruction at accessible vent sections.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not dismantle venting; arrange qualified service for any concern or suspected combustion issue.

name: Review reusable HVAC filter condition
description: If the system uses a washable filter, clean it and reinstall it only when completely dry.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Only use washable-filter procedures for filters explicitly designed to be reused.

name: Review household fire escape routes
description: Check that exits, windows, and escape paths are accessible and that household members know the plan.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Adapt the plan to household needs and local fire-safety guidance.

name: Practice household fire escape plan
description: Practice the household escape plan and identify an outdoor meeting location.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Include children, visitors, and anyone needing assistance.

name: Review fire extinguisher service dates
description: Check service tags and expiration or replacement guidance for each extinguisher.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use a qualified fire-equipment service provider when inspection or servicing is required.

name: Inspect first-aid kit supplies
description: Check supplies, packaging, and expiration dates; replenish missing essentials.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Choose supplies appropriate for household needs and training.

name: Test emergency flashlights and lighting
description: Test flashlights, lanterns, and emergency lights and replace or recharge batteries as needed.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow battery and device instructions; store emergency lights accessibly.

name: Review carbon monoxide alarm replacement dates
description: Check manufacture or replacement dates on all carbon monoxide alarms.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Replace alarms at the interval specified by the manufacturer, not solely when a battery expires.

name: Review smoke alarm replacement dates
description: Check manufacture or replacement dates on all smoke alarms.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Many alarms have a finite service life; follow the exact model label and manufacturer instructions.

name: Visually inspect accessible fire sprinkler heads
description: If installed, look for painted, damaged, corroded, obstructed, or leaking sprinkler heads.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not touch, paint, test, or modify sprinkler components; contact a qualified fire-sprinkler contractor.

name: Review household emergency supplies
description: Check stored water, shelf-stable food, batteries, radio, and other household emergency supplies.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Adjust supplies for household size, local hazards, and public emergency guidance.

name: Locate and inspect main water shutoff access
description: Confirm the main shutoff location is accessible and identify how to operate it safely.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not force a seized valve; ask a plumber to service it.

name: Check household water pressure
description: Use a suitable pressure gauge at an approved hose connection and note unusual changes.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Compare readings with local plumbing guidance and equipment requirements; consult a plumber if abnormal.

name: Inspect pressure-reducing valve condition
description: If installed, look for visible leaks or corrosion around the pressure-reducing valve and note pressure changes.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Adjustment and replacement should be handled by a qualified plumber.

name: Inspect water heater and connections for leaks
description: Look around the tank or unit, fittings, drain pan, and nearby floor for moisture or corrosion.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not remove covers or operate gas, electrical, or pressure components.

name: Review water heater anode-rod service interval
description: Check the manual and service history to determine whether anode inspection or replacement is due.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Anode work varies by model and water chemistry; use a qualified technician when appropriate.

name: Inspect faucet and toilet supply connections
description: Check accessible shutoff valves, braided lines, and connections for corrosion, bulging, or moisture.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Replace deteriorated components promptly; do not overtighten fittings.

name: Clean sink drain stoppers
description: Remove accessible hair and debris from bathroom and utility sink stoppers.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use methods compatible with the drain and fixture; avoid mixing drain chemicals.

name: Review backflow preventer inspection status
description: If installed, check the test tag and arrange required testing or service.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Testing requirements vary by jurisdiction; use a certified tester where required.

name: Clean oven interior
description: Clean the oven using the manufacturer's approved method and inspect the door seal.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not use self-cleaning cycles or cleaners contrary to the appliance manual.

name: Clean microwave interior and vents
description: Clean the interior, door seal, turntable, and accessible ventilation openings.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Unplug before cleaning; never remove the outer cabinet.

name: Inspect freezer for excess ice buildup
description: Check door seals, vents, and frost accumulation; defrost only if the model requires it.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow the appliance manual; frost-free models generally should not need manual defrosting.

name: Clean refrigerator ice maker components
description: If installed, clean accessible ice bin and approved removable components.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow the refrigerator manual and use only approved cleaning methods.

name: Inspect garbage disposal operation
description: Check for unusual noise, leaks, odor, and proper operation using the manufacturer's procedure.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Disconnect power before cleaning; never put hands inside the disposal.

name: Descale coffee maker or espresso machine
description: Descale the appliance if required by its indicator or maintenance schedule.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use the manufacturer's recommended descaling product and interval.

name: Visually inspect electrical panel exterior
description: Look for visible damage, corrosion, water intrusion, unusual heat, or blocked access.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not remove the panel cover; have concerns assessed by a licensed electrician.

name: Test AFCI protection where test buttons are provided
description: Use the breaker manufacturer's test procedure for accessible AFCI devices.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow device instructions; contact an electrician if a breaker fails its test or will not reset.

name: Inspect outdoor electrical receptacles and covers
description: Check accessible outdoor outlet covers for damage, missing seals, or moisture intrusion.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not open electrical boxes; have damaged devices repaired by a qualified electrician.

name: Inspect household extension cords
description: Check cords and plugs for cuts, crushed insulation, loose connections, or heat damage.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Remove damaged cords from service; do not use extension cords as permanent wiring.

name: Arrange standby generator transfer-system inspection
description: If installed, review the transfer switch and generator maintenance schedule with a qualified provider.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Never open transfer equipment or attempt live electrical testing yourself.

name: Review surge protector status
description: Check status indicators and replacement guidance for plug-in and whole-home surge protection.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Replace devices when indicators or manufacturer instructions require it.

name: Inspect exterior lighting and photocells
description: Check outdoor fixtures, motion sensors, and photocell operation; replace failed lamps where appropriate.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Turn off power before replacing lamps and use weather-rated components.

name: Inspect interior paint and wall finishes
description: Look for peeling, staining, cracking, or damage that may indicate moisture or movement.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Investigate the cause of recurring stains or cracks before repainting.

name: Inspect flooring and transition strips
description: Check for loose transitions, lifted edges, damaged boards, or trip hazards.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Repair loose or raised flooring promptly to reduce trip risk.

name: Deep-clean carpets and area rugs
description: Clean carpets and rugs using a method appropriate for their material.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow flooring and rug care instructions; allow materials to dry fully.

name: Inspect interior doors and hardware
description: Check hinges, latches, handles, and door alignment; tighten loose hardware where appropriate.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use compatible fasteners and do not alter fire-rated door assemblies.

name: Inspect window glazing and visible seals
description: Look for cracked glass, failed visible seals, condensation between panes, or damaged glazing.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use a qualified glazier for cracked glass or failed insulated glazing.

name: Check moisture-prone interior areas
description: Look around laundry, bathrooms, under sinks, and exterior-wall corners for dampness or mold-like growth.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Address moisture sources promptly; seek qualified remediation for extensive growth.

name: Inspect exterior siding and trim
description: Look for loose, cracked, warped, or missing siding and trim.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use safe ground-level viewing; arrange qualified repairs for elevated areas.

name: Inspect exterior paint and coatings
description: Look for peeling, exposed substrate, failed coatings, or areas needing maintenance.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow coating manufacturer guidance and use lead-safe practices for older painted surfaces.

name: Arrange professional roof flashing inspection
description: Review visible flashing condition and arrange closer inspection if staining or damage is observed.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not climb onto the roof; use a qualified roofing contractor.

name: Inspect soffits and fascia from ground
description: Look for loose panels, rot, pest openings, or water staining along roof edges.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not access elevated areas without proper equipment and training.

name: Check downspout discharge and extensions
description: Verify downspouts are connected and discharge water away from the foundation.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Maintain positive drainage without directing water onto neighboring property.

name: Inspect driveway and walkways
description: Look for trip hazards, significant cracks, settlement, and drainage problems.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Repair hazards promptly and use appropriate materials for the surface.

name: Inspect fences and gates
description: Check posts, rails, latches, hinges, and visible rot or corrosion.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Check property boundaries and local rules before repairs or replacement.

name: Inspect retaining walls and visible drainage
description: Look for leaning, bulging, new cracks, displaced blocks, or blocked drainage outlets.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Keep away from visibly unstable walls and seek a qualified structural professional.

name: Clean and inspect window wells
description: Remove debris from accessible window wells and check that drains are not visibly blocked.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use safe access methods; do not enter deep or confined window wells.

name: Inspect exterior caulking and sealant
description: Check around doors, windows, penetrations, and joints for failed or missing sealant.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use sealants compatible with the materials and intended exposure.

name: Start up irrigation system for the season
description: Open the system gradually and inspect zones, valves, heads, and visible leaks.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Start after freeze risk has passed; follow system instructions and local watering rules.

name: Inspect sprinkler heads and coverage
description: Check for broken, tilted, clogged, or misdirected sprinkler heads.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Adjust watering to local restrictions and landscape needs.

name: Inspect irrigation valves and valve boxes
description: Look for leaks, damaged wiring, standing water, or debris in accessible valve boxes.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use a qualified irrigation technician for electrical or buried-line repairs.

name: Inspect drip irrigation emitters and tubing
description: Check accessible drip lines for leaks, clogged emitters, and damaged tubing.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Flush and service filters according to system instructions.

name: Review irrigation backflow device test status
description: If installed, check certification or test dates and arrange required testing.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow local cross-connection rules and use a certified tester where required.

name: Inspect trees near the home
description: Look for dead limbs, major cracks, leaning, or branches contacting the roof and service lines.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not climb or cut large limbs; consult a qualified arborist.

name: Clear yard and area drains
description: Remove leaves and debris from accessible surface drains and grates.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not enter storm drains or confined drainage structures.

name: Check landscape grading near foundation
description: Look for settled soil or areas that direct water toward the house.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Avoid changes that redirect water onto neighboring properties; seek advice for persistent drainage issues.

name: Service lawn mower before or after season
description: Review blade, deck, tires, and maintenance items according to the equipment manual.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Disconnect the spark plug or power source before maintenance and follow safety instructions.

name: Inspect outdoor hose bibs and hose connections
description: Check for drips, loose fittings, damaged vacuum breakers, or leaks while in use.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Prepare hose bibs for freezing weather using the plumbing manufacturer's instructions.

name: Trim vegetation away from house exterior
description: Check that shrubs and branches do not trap moisture against siding or obstruct vents and access.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Avoid damaging utility lines, nesting wildlife, or protected vegetation.

name: Complete spring exterior walkthrough
description: Walk the property and identify winter damage, drainage issues, and deferred exterior maintenance.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use this as a seasonal review; create separate tasks for repairs that need tracking.

name: Prepare home for summer cooling season
description: Review cooling system readiness, shading, window screens, and accessible condensate drainage.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow HVAC and window manufacturer guidance; arrange professional service when needed.

name: Prepare home for heating season
description: Review heating readiness, thermostat operation, filters, and visible venting before cold weather.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Have fuel-burning equipment serviced by a qualified technician as recommended.

name: Prepare doors and windows for cold weather
description: Check weatherstripping, storm windows, door sweeps, and visible gaps before winter.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use compatible materials and maintain required ventilation and combustion-air openings.

name: Review freeze protection for vulnerable pipes
description: Identify exposed or vulnerable pipes and confirm approved freeze-protection measures are in place.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not use open flames; follow plumbing and heating equipment instructions.

name: Review roof snow and ice safety plan
description: Identify safe procedures and service contacts for heavy snow or ice conditions.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not climb onto icy roofs; follow local safety guidance and use qualified contractors.

name: Check seasonal exterior seals and screens
description: Review screens, storm panels, door sweeps, and removable seasonal seals.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Store removed components dry and follow product instructions.

name: Refresh seasonal emergency kit
description: Review supplies for expected seasonal hazards such as winter storms, heat, or wildfire smoke.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow local emergency-management recommendations.

name: Arrange private well system inspection
description: If the home uses a private well, review pump operation, pressure tank condition, and inspection or water-test schedule.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use qualified well professionals and follow local health department water-testing guidance.

name: Test private well water quality
description: If applicable, arrange laboratory testing for locally recommended contaminants.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Testing frequency and analytes should follow local public-health guidance and known well risks.

name: Arrange septic system inspection
description: If installed, arrange a qualified inspection of the tank, distribution components, and system condition.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Inspection and pumping intervals depend on system design, occupancy, and local requirements.

name: Review septic tank pumping schedule
description: Check service records and determine whether pumping is due based on system guidance.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not open or enter septic tanks; use a licensed septic service provider.

name: Service standby generator
description: If installed, complete the generator manufacturer's scheduled maintenance.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Use qualified service for fuel, exhaust, and electrical work; follow manufacturer run-test instructions.

name: Inspect pool equipment and safety systems
description: If applicable, review pump, filter, visible plumbing, barriers, and safety equipment.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow pool equipment instructions and local pool-barrier and electrical-safety requirements.

name: Service spa or hot tub equipment
description: If installed, review pumps, filters, covers, and water-care equipment.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow manufacturer water-care and electrical-safety instructions.

name: Check radon mitigation system operation
description: If installed, verify the system indicator and review the date of the last radon test.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Follow local public-health guidance and arrange testing or repairs with qualified providers.

name: Inspect accessible crawlspace conditions
description: From a safe access point, look for standing water, plumbing leaks, damaged vapor barrier, or pest entry.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not enter unsafe or confined spaces; use qualified professionals for inspections and repairs.

name: Review residential solar system condition
description: If installed, review monitoring alerts and look for visible damage from a safe ground-level location.
recommendation_note: Starting recommendation only. Do not climb onto the roof or open electrical equipment; use a qualified solar contractor.
